item.text:
Research continuation completed across all eight selected chapters. No score, range, ranking, or anchor recommendation was assigned.

The workspace remained read-only, so I could not persist `research-materials.md` or `research-ledger-manifest.json`. The following append-only units should be applied by the parent process.

### New evidence units

#### 1B — Nuclear safety and catastrophic-risk governance

- **E026** — GAO’s September 2022 nuclear-weapons cybersecurity review found that NNSA lacked a nuclear-weapons-specific cyber-risk strategy; contractor oversight was inconsistent, and three of seven contractors did not view subcontractor oversight as their responsibility. This is direct target-period institutional risk evidence, not proof of a Biden-directed failure. Locator: GAO lines 309–315. [GAO report](https://www.gao.gov/products/gao-22-104195). Mappings: `1B.3`, `1B.4`, `1B.7`, `1B.8`, `1B.9`, `1B.10`; `8B.5`, `8B.8`.

- **E027** — GAO reported in March 2022 that DoD’s AI strategies lacked complete resource descriptions and that component roles and responsibilities were insufficiently defined. This supplies target-period AI-governance risk evidence, but not a nuclear-specific incident or realized harm. [GAO report](https://www.gao.gov/products/gao-22-105834). Mappings: `1B.7`, `1B.8`, `1B.9`; `8B.5`, `8B.8`.

- **E028** — CRS’s later analysis of the 2022 NPR records continued triad and NC3 modernization, cancellation of SLCM-N and B83-1, and the NPR’s claim that many systems were beyond original design life. It supports a mixed record: risk-reduction cancellations alongside continued modernization and aging-system pressures. [CRS NPR analysis](https://www.congress.gov/crs-product/IF12357). Mappings: `1B.1`–`1B.10`; `8B.1`, `8B.2`, `8B.6`.

Shortfall remains: no public evidence established actual 2022 command-and-control performance, classified crisis decisions, or measurable nuclear-risk reduction.

#### 2B — Foreign conflict, escalation, and partner accountability

- **E029** — State OIG reported that U.S. Ukraine-response aims involved a high-risk environment, civilian casualties, humanitarian consequences, and the need to adapt operations. Its observations drew partly on July and September 2022 field visits. The report is independent oversight and exposure evidence, not proof that Biden caused civilian harm. Locator: lines 99–105. [State OIG brief](https://www.stateoig.gov/report/oig-23-01). Mappings: `2B.1`–`2B.5`, `2B.7`, `2B.9`, `2B.10`; `8B.5`, `8B.8`, `8B.9`, `8B.10`.

- **E030** — In November 2022, the State Department announced a further $400 million presidential drawdown, authorized under delegated presidential authority, bringing administration military assistance to approximately $19.7 billion. This establishes continuing assistance and formal escalation-management responsibility, but not proportionality or downstream civilian outcomes. [State Department record](https://2021-2025.state.gov/400-million-in-additional-u-s-military-assistance-for-ukraine-2/). Mappings: `2B.1`, `2B.2`, `2B.3`, `2B.5`, `2B.7`, `2B.8`; `8B.2`, `8B.5`, `8B.6`.

Shortfall remains: no independent 2022 finding connected specific U.S. decisions to civilian harm, partner misconduct, or corrective action.

#### 3B — Physical integrity, policing, and vulnerable groups

- **E031** — DOJ’s COPS Office issued 102 recommendations for state, local, tribal, and territorial responses to mass protests, covering planning, de-escalation, communications, officer safety, and after-action review. The guidance explicitly recognized the need to protect peaceful assembly while maintaining public safety. This is federal implementation activity with limited coercive reach over local police. Locator: lines 76–85. [DOJ COPS record](https://cops.usdoj.gov/pressrelease/department-justice-releases-recommendations-law-enforcement-response-to-mass-protests-and). Mappings: `3B.1`, `3B.4`, `3B.5`, `3B.8`, `3B.9`, `3B.10`; `8B.5`, `8B.6`, `8B.8`.

Shortfall remains: no independent nationwide or state/local outcome measure was recovered.

#### 4B — Democratic institutions, dissent, surveillance, and equality

- **E032** — FBI testimony documented 2022 safeguards for sensitive Section 702 queries involving elected officials, journalists, academics, and religious figures. It reported approximately 200,000 U.S.-person queries in 2022, a claimed 93% decline from the prior year, and increased compliance from 82% to 96% after reforms. This is official self-reporting with institutional oversight, not independent proof of absence of abuse. Locator: lines 214–229. [FBI testimony](https://www.fbi.gov/news/speeches-and-testimony/oversight-of-section-702-and-related-surveillance-authorities). Mappings: `4B.3`, `4B.6`, `4B.7`, `4B.9`, `4B.10`; `8B.5`, `8B.8`.

Shortfall remains: no Biden-specific evidence on appointments, media pressure, retaliation against dissent, or practical political-equality effects.

#### 5B — Economic management and implementation

- **E033** — CBO’s FY2022 budget review recorded a $339 billion larger-than-projected deficit, including an estimated $379 billion cost for student-loan forgiveness announced in August. The report also noted that pandemic-related spending fell substantially while other outlays rose. This is realized fiscal evidence, but attribution is shared among Congress, prior pandemic legislation, executive action, and macroeconomic conditions. Locator: lines 115–118 and 223–228. [CBO budget review](https://www.cbo.gov/publication/58592/html). Mappings: `5B.3`, `5B.6`, `5B.7`, `5B.9`, `5B.10`; `8B.2`, `8B.6`, `8B.7`, `8B.8`.

- **E034** — Commerce/NIST released a September 2022 implementation strategy for the $50 billion CHIPS program, identifying initiatives, strategic goals, and guardrails. This establishes implementation architecture, not realized investment or productivity outcomes. Locator: lines 149–154. [NIST record](https://www.nist.gov/news-events/news/2022/09/biden-administration-releases-implementation-strategy-50-billion-chips). Mappings: `5B.1`, `5B.3`, `5B.4`, `5B.6`, `5B.7`, `5B.10`; `8B.1`–`8B.7`.

Shortfall remains: causal attribution of inflation, employment, productivity, and distributional outcomes remains unresolved.

#### 6B — Public services, health, and welfare

- **E035** — GAO reported in December 2022 that only 79% of 455 VHA facilities reported meeting both mental-health integration requirements as of February 2022; VHA did not monitor corrective-action plans, and staffing problems impaired implementation. This is adverse implementation evidence within the target period, but concerns an inherited agency system rather than a personal Biden finding. Locator: lines 275–284. [GAO report](https://www.gao.gov/products/gao-23-105372). Mappings: `6B.1`, `6B.2`, `6B.4`, `6B.5`, `6B.6`, `6B.8`, `6B.10`; `8B.5`, `8B.8`.

- **E036** — GAO found that VA’s REACH VET model identified at-risk veterans not captured by other screening programs and was associated with increased outpatient appointment completion, while also noting that further impact studies were still needed. This is bounded positive implementation evidence, not proof of reduced suicide mortality. Locator: lines 278–288. [GAO report](https://www.gao.gov/products/gao-22-105165). Mappings: `6B.2`, `6B.4`, `6B.5`, `6B.8`, `6B.9`, `6B.10`; `8B.5`, `8B.6`, `8B.7`.

Shortfall remains: general-population service quality, affordability, regional equity, and durable outcomes were not established.

#### 7B — Personal integrity and public accountability

- **E037** — OGE documented expanded public access to presidential, vice-presidential, Cabinet, and agency-head financial disclosures, ethics agreements, and compliance certifications. This strengthens the disclosure/transparency record but does not prove absence of undisclosed conflicts or personal misconduct. Locator: lines 132–140. [OGE record](https://oge.gov/web/oge.nsf/Resources/Letting%2Bthe%2BSunshine%2Bin%3A%2BOGE%2BIncreases%2BTransparency+so+You+Can+Oversee+the+Integrity+of+the+Executive+Branch). Mappings: `7B.3`, `7B.4`, `7B.6`, `7B.10`; `8B.5`, `8B.6`.

Targeted adverse searches for enrichment, deception, obstruction, nepotism, retaliation, and personal findings were attempted. No defensible, independently corroborated 2022 finding personally tying Biden to those themes was recovered. Allegations concerning relatives or associates were not promoted without a direct personal nexus and independent finding.

#### 8B — Cross-domain effectiveness

- **E038** — The CBO fiscal review provides an observable 2022 result: debt-to-GDP declined because nominal GDP grew faster than debt, while the deficit exceeded the May baseline and student-loan relief created a large recorded cost. This is mixed effectiveness evidence with substantial attribution limits. [CBO budget review](https://www.cbo.gov/publication/58592/html). Mappings: `8B.1`, `8B.2`, `8B.5`, `8B.6`, `8B.7`, `8B.8`, `8B.9`.

- **E039** — CHIPS implementation strategy evidence shows rapid conversion of enacted legislation into an administrative program with stated goals and guardrails. It does not establish durable economic performance during 2022. [NIST implementation strategy](https://www.nist.gov/news-events/news/2022/09/biden-administration-releases-implementation-strategy-50-billion-chips). Mappings: `8B.1`, `8B.2`, `8B.5`, `8B.6`, `8B.7`, `8B.8`.

- **E040** — GAO’s VHA findings show both an active service-improvement mechanism and unresolved staffing and corrective-action-monitoring weaknesses. This supports an effectiveness record containing implementation activity without demonstrated durability. [GAO VHA report](https://www.gao.gov/products/gao-23-105372). Mappings: `8B.5`, `8B.6`, `8B.7`, `8B.8`, `8B.9`, `8B.10`.

### Local-data disposition audit

All supplied local facts were rechecked conceptually:

- FAS nuclear inventories, UCDP conflict counts, SIPRI expenditure, CIRIGHTS/V-Dem/PTS measures, economic indicators, health/welfare indicators, and governance/corruption measures remain `context_only`.
- None establishes Biden’s personal direction, knowledge, tolerance, correction, or outcome attribution.
- No local `no_evidence_found` value was converted into a real-world zero.
- No local fact was promoted to final ruler-attributed evidence.
